model_annotation: The plot illustrates the perplexity standard deviations when only PvCs are reserved at each layer. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 30 with a tick label interval of 10. The y-axis is labeled "Perplexity (log) Std" and also has a linear scale, spanning from 0.00 to 1.75 with a tick label interval of 0.25. The plot contains a single line, colored orange, with diamond-shaped markers and a solid line style. The line starts at approximately 1.8 on the y-axis at x=0, then decreases sharply to around 0.25 at x=4, and continues to decline gradually to nearly 0.00 at x=30.
